title: Deepwood Survey
description: Before Sylas commits the muster to the southern thicket he wants it surveyed: how deep the rot runs, and how hard the bloodthorn fights near the old stones. Burn back a swathe of lashers and gather live blossoms to mark the sickest ground. Hard, but a seasoned hand can manage it alone.

objectives.desc: Mark the sickest ground with live blossoms
